generationOutcome.sql: SELECT t1.patient_id, t2.family_name, t1.medication_name FROM analytics.hiv_medication_request_fact_v1 AS t1 JOIN analytics.hiv_patient_dim_v1 AS t2 ON t1.patient_id = t2.patient_id

SELECT t1.patient_id, t2.family_name, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t1.medication_name, ', ') AS medications FROM analytics.hiv_medication_request_fact_v1 AS t1 JOIN analytics.hiv_patient_dim_v1 AS t2 ON t1.patient_id = t2.patient_id GROUP BY t1.patient_id, t2.family_name
